$comment: Catalogue of Kenyan economic series the platform is designed to display. DEFINITIONS AND SOURCES ONLY — no observations are stored here. Observations are ingested separately (see docs/economy-data.md), because economic data has its own publishers, licences and release calendars and must never be scraped or estimated.

series.name: Inflation rate (CPI, year-on-year)
series.description: Annual consumer price inflation as published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics.
series.license: Published by KNBS. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: Central Bank Rate (CBR)
series.description: Policy rate set by the Monetary Policy Committee of the Central Bank of Kenya.
series.license: Published by CBK. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: 91-day Treasury bill rate
series.description: Weighted average accepted rate on the 91-day Treasury bill; benchmark short-term rate.
series.license: Published by CBK. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: Commercial bank average lending rate
series.description: Weighted average commercial bank lending rate.
series.license: Published by CBK. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: USD / KES exchange rate
series.description: Central Bank of Kenya indicative exchange rate for the US dollar.
series.license: Published by CBK. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: Real GDP growth (year-on-year)
series.description: Quarterly national accounts growth published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics.
series.license: Published by KNBS. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.

series.name: Trade balance
series.description: Value of exports minus imports of goods.
series.license: Published by KNBS. Confirm redistribution terms before commercial use.
